content: Original curator paraphrase of the primary CME Group Futures Order Types lesson: a trader may exit part of a multi-contract position at one price and exit the remainder at another price. This establishes partial position exits as a genuine order-management technique. The lesson does not specify a fifty-percent allocation, ATR-based partial target, ATR trailing distance or holding-period optimum. Those settings and the existing simulator's simplified accounting in this supplement are separately declared lab hypotheses, not CME recommendations or profitable-strategy evidence.
